newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, seen oscillating.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, seen oscillating.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.22 percent on Monday and traders forecast the blue-chip SBI index would remain pinned in a narrow wage this week.
"The market is in waiting mode for the return of foreign investors. Until then volumes will remain low," a trader said.
* The SBI index fell 3.48 points to 1,314.99.
* Issue A of drug company Lek was most actively traded, down 1.11 percent to 24,080 tolars.
